process_learnings: A retro audit that only validates historical files must also fail on stale newest-retro dates.
Devin AI review remediation and git-push-and-wait belong in project memory because they change future review and delivery behavior.
Backfilled or branch-local retro metrics must state their branch and uncommitted-work boundary.
